title: Access the RSA, RCG and ARCG course management portal
summary: This page provides information for Approved Training Providers (ATPs) on how to use the online portal to manage industry training courses.
intro:
Approved training providers (ATPs) are authorised by Liquor & Gaming NSW to deliver industry training in:

### ATP portal

ATPs who manage training courses use the online ATP portal to:
who_can_apply: Approved Training Providers (ATPs) who manage training courses
what_you_need: A unique email address (not shared or generic)
An activation email from the ATP portal administrator in your Registered Training Organisation (RTO)
The ability to create a password and set up multi-factor authentication

external_links.text: Training online portal system – Liquor & Gaming NSW

faqs.q: Where can I find up-to-date information and resources for liquor and gaming training?
faqs.a: Visit Liquor & Gaming NSW: Training for up-to-date information, resources and tools.

faqs.q: Who should I contact if I have questions about liquor and gaming training?
How do I access the ATP portal for the first time?
faqs.a: You need to activate an account. For the portal, use the link provided for the Training online portal system – Liquor & Gaming NSW.
